title: Finite Cech criterion for derived evaluation on the coherent profinite site
statement: Let F be an abelian sheaf on the coherent site of u-small profinite sets, with coefficient groups in universe u+1 [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Suppose the chosen alternating Cech cohomology [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex] of F vanishes in every positive degree for every finite jointly surjective covering family indexed by a Type 0 finite set, for every choice of fibre products. Then every positive right derived evaluation of F at every profinite object is zero, including the empty object.

source.place: Tag 03F9 (lemma-cech-vanish-collection), hypotheses (1)–(3), with all profinite objects and all finite jointly surjective covers.

proof.text: A coherent covering sieve contains a finite effective epimorphic family. Reindex it by Fin n, and use the profinite effective-epi-family criterion to identify it with a jointly surjective family. It refines the original sieve; all its nerve objects are profinite.

Choose a SiteCechComplex for each such cover. The private product-comparison construction identifies it with the categorical Cech complex. Universal properties identify the fibre products, and the tuple-product comparison commutes with all deletion maps, hence with the alternating differential. The private version separates index and coefficient universes, which are tied in the published SiteCechMathlibComparison signature. Hypothesized zero homology gives exactness in all positive degrees.
Apply the categorical finite Cech criterion with B all profinite objects and the preceding cofinal finite covering families. Its conclusion is precisely positive derived evaluation vanishing.

lean.statement:
theorem isZero_rightDerived_eval_of_profinite_cech
    (F : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hcech : ∀ (V : Profinite.{u}) (T : Type) [Finite T]
      (W : T → Profinite.{u}) (f : ∀ t, W t ⟶ V),
      (∀ v : V, ∃ t, ∃ w : W t, f t w = v) →
      ∀ (S : SiteCechComplex W f) (q : ℕ), 0 < q →
        IsZero ((S.cohomologyFunctor q).obj F.obj))
    (V : Profinite.{u}) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    IsZero (((sheafToPresheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ⋙
      (evaluation Profinite.{u}ᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (op V)).rightDerived q).obj F)
